decision.next_action: If this gate fails, close local raw HR/light/screen event reconstruction as an immediate ID342 overlay route. If it passes but remains far above Public 0.55, keep it report-only and pivot to validation/public-gap redesign before any artifact.

feature_contract.domain_read: S3 approximates sleep-onset latency via settling into no-screen, darkness, charging, stillness, and HR drop. S4 approximates WASO via post-onset HR spikes, light/screen/movement interruptions, and fragmented low-HR/dark/still runs. All features are label-free raw-sequence summaries.

purpose: Test whether sequence-level HR/light/screen/charging/activity/step event proxies add stable S4/S3 signal beyond ID342 after direct raw sleep-event reconstruction proved unavailable.
